scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:infra:up && npm run e2e:run
scripts.e2e:ui: npm run e2e:infra:up && npm run e2e:run:ui
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.test:ci: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml -f docker-compose.test.ci.yml run --rm server-test && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml -f docker-compose.test.ci.yml run --rm client-test
scripts.lint:ci: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml -f docker-compose.test.ci.yml run --rm server-lint && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml -f docker-compose.test.ci.yml run --rm client-lint
scripts.ci: npm run test:ci && npm run lint:ci
